title: Seven-vendor official-source model timeline audit
scope_note: This audits all 223 assigned baseline rows and broad named public model/endpoint families, not every research artifact, internal model, quantization, or worldwide model. A verified date is tied to the explicit event stage, not necessarily first public weights or universal availability.
methodology: Keep announcement, research paper, restricted/public preview, product/API launch, GA and open weights separate.
Never derive release day merely from model ID suffix, source crawl date or last-updated stamp.
Same trained model with a new serving tier or GA status is a lifecycle milestone; preserve genuine named checkpoint versions.
A later successor is not evidence an older model retired; distinguish app demo withdrawal from weight/service retirement.
Official catalog inconsistencies are recorded; no silent extrapolation of precise day from a month.
